description: Adobe Firefly image-generation credits through BU Adobe Creative Cloud access.
howToObtain: Use BU Adobe Creative Cloud eligibility; access differs by student status and faculty primary teaching affiliation.
costToUser: No cost for students and many faculty; otherwise $75 per year.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Boston University's official AIDA supported-tools catalogue says Adobe Creative Cloud includes Firefly image-generation credits and is available at no cost only to students and faculty eligible through their primary teaching affiliation; users who need to pay are charged $75 per year.

description: BU Google Workspace Gemini with enterprise data protections.
howToObtain: Use Gemini in a browser while signed in to an active BU Google Workspace account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: BU TechWeb says Google Gemini is available to all staff, faculty, and students at no additional cost under BU's Google Workspace license. An active BU student, faculty, or staff member with a BU Google Workspace account can access it.

description: Google Workspace Studio automation using Gemini within the BU Google Workspace environment.
howToObtain: Use the Studio workspace or supported Google apps with an active BU Google Workspace account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: BU TechWeb's Google Workspace license service page says active BU students, faculty, and staff with a BU Google Workspace account can access Google Workspace Studio through the Studio workspace or common Google apps.

description: Paid Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on for BU faculty and staff.
howToObtain: Submit an IS&T request for a license.
costToUser: Approximately $360 per user per year, prorated at request.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Boston University's AIDA supported-tools catalogue says Microsoft 365 Copilot is available to faculty and staff only for approximately $360 per user per year. A license must be requested from IS&T through an Internal Service Request.

description: BU enterprise Microsoft Copilot Chat with protected data handling.
howToObtain: Use Microsoft Copilot in a browser or Microsoft Edge while signed in to a BU Microsoft account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: BU TechWeb says Microsoft Copilot Chat is available to all staff, faculty, and students at no additional cost under BU's enterprise Microsoft license. Active BU students, faculty, and staff with a Microsoft 365 license can access it using their BU Microsoft account.

description: Basic NotebookLM access bundled with BU Google Gemini.
howToObtain: Use NotebookLM in a browser while signed in to an active BU Google Workspace account.
costToUser: No cost for the bundled basic access.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: BU TechWeb says Gemini is available at no additional cost under BU's Google Workspace license and that Google Gemini access bundles basic NotebookLM access. Active BU students, faculty, and staff with a BU Google Workspace account can access NotebookLM; advanced features may be unavailable.

description: BU's secure AI chat platform provides paid leading-model access for the BU community.
howToObtain: Sign in to TerrierGPT with a BU Kerberos login.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Boston University's official AIDA page says TerrierGPT provides the BU community secure, flexible, free access to paid leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and more. BU faculty, staff, and students access the platform with Kerberos login.

description: AI Companion features for BU Zoom meetings, including transcription and meeting summaries.
howToObtain: Open BU Zoom Website Settings and enable the applicable AI Companion features.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Boston University's official AIDA supported-tools catalogue says Zoom AI Companion is enabled through BU Zoom Website Settings, where users can turn on appropriate features for their meetings. It is not permitted in the HIPAA environment.
